title: Mä Reino pʼakjkäna uka represa
intro: Jawiranakan jawira, pä ch’uxña jardinanaka ukat jan uñtasit suma qamañ uraqi — ukampis ukan jakirinakax khititix jupanakar bendiciwayki ukarux jan yäqasaw jilxattapxäna. Kunapachatï amtayäwinakajj jupanakar kuttʼayasajj purinkäna ukhajja, maysaruw kuttʼapjjäna. Kunatï uka qhepat utjkäna ukajj mä castigowa, ukajj jichhakamaw mä ewjjtʼarjam istʼasi. ¿Khitis uka nayra markachäna?
clues: Mä bendicionan oraqen jakasipjjayäta, ukatwa utajajj pä chʼojjña jardinanak taypinkäna.
Uraqinakajan jawiranakax saraski ukat walja cosechanakax utanakajaruw phuqhantat uñjasipxirïta.
Ukampis Tatitusar yuspärañataki ukat istʼañataki jawsatäpkta ukhajja, jachʼa jachʼa tukusaw jitheqtapjjta.
Qamir kankañasa ukat jan chʼamäñasa, khititï taqe ukanak churkitäna ukat armasjjapjjayätwa.
Ukat mä akatjamat mä jawiraw purinïna, uka jawirajj atinisipkayäta uka jachʼa jarkʼatwa pʼakjäna.
Jiwasax Saba’ markankir jaqinakätanwa, jupanakan uraqipax jach’a Ma’rib Represa ukamp uñt’atawa.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
